_about: T-FFTRadNet (Giroux et al., ICCV 2023 BRAVO workshop) model block from the reference repo (jgiroux8/T_FFTRadNet 68bc041) config/*_config.json. input_mode picks the input and must match the chosen feature (RD modes -> feature RD, ADC -> ADC, RAD modes -> RAD). RADIal: RD (stored radar_FFT), RD_shift_as_published (RD from ADC, Doppler shift discarded as the reference's Custom_RD), RD_shift (shift applied), RD_no_window, ADC. RADDetDataset: RAD (built from ADC as the reference does), RAD_stored (magnitude of the stored RAD cubes), RD, RD_no_window, ADC. fourier_doppler_shift and fourier_activation ('linear' or 'nl') apply to ADC only. in_chans follows from dataset and mode.
